title: Finite affine refinement charts and local module models at one limit stage
statement:
Let $I$ be a small nonempty directed set and $(S_i,p_{ji})_{i\in I}$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme], where $p_{ji}:S_j\to S_i$ for $j\geq i$ is affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Assume each $S_i$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. Let $S=\varprojlim_i S_i$ be the scheme limit with projections $p_i$ (so compatible families of maps from any scheme into the $S_i$ factor uniquely through $S$). For sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], finite presentation means locally admitting an exact sequence $\mathcal O^m\to\mathcal O^n\to F\to0$ with finite $m,n$. All pullbacks are tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback], with their canonical composition identifications.
Fix $i_0\in I$ and a finitely presented $\mathcal O_S$-module $F$. Choose a finite affine open cover $(U_a)$ of $S$, finite affine covers $(W_{ab,r})$ of each $U_a\cap U_b$, finite affine covers of the intersections $W_{ab,r}\cap W_{ab,r'}$, and finite affine covers $(T_{abc,s})$ of triple intersections, subordinate to the three chosen pair covers. Empty covers are permitted for empty opens. Such a finite collection exists. Denote its finitely many labelled affine opens by $C_d$, recording all specified inclusions between them. Then there exist $i\geq i_0$, affine opens $C_{d,i}\subseteq S_i$ and finitely presented quasi-coherent modules $N_{d,i}$ [pqf-def-coherent] on $C_{d,i}$ with the following properties.
(1) $p_i^{-1}C_{d,i}=C_d$. Every specified inclusion and every covering equation in the chosen collection holds at stage $i$: the $U_{a,i}$ cover $S_i$, the $W_{ab,r,i}$ cover $U_{a,i}\cap U_{b,i}$, the overlap refinements cover the corresponding pair-chart intersections, and the subordinate triple charts cover $U_{a,i}\cap U_{b,i}\cap U_{c,i}$.
(2) For $j\geq i$ put $C_{d,j}=p_{ji}^{-1}C_{d,i}$. These are affine, their restricted inverse system has limit $C_d$, and the canonical maps induce $\varinjlim_{j\geq i}\Gamma(C_{d,j},\mathcal O)\cong\Gamma(C_d,\mathcal O)$.
(3) For the restricted projection $q_d:C_d\to C_{d,i}$ there is an isomorphism $e_d:q_d^*N_{d,i}\xrightarrow{\sim}F|_{C_d}$. On affine sections this is an isomorphism $\Gamma(C_d,\mathcal O)\otimes_{\Gamma(C_{d,i},\mathcal O)}\Gamma(C_{d,i},N_{d,i})\cong\Gamma(C_d,F)$ via the canonical tensor-pullback sections comparison. No transition maps between distinct $N_{d,i}$ are asserted.

proof.text: The limit projections are affine by Mathlib isAffineHom_π_app. Its quasi-compactness follows from Scheme.compactSpace_of_isLimit; its quasi-separatedness follows from an affine projection to the fixed quasi-separated stage. Apply the finite refinement existence lemma to the limit.

Retain the arbitrary valid labelled collection. Descend every labelled affine open and take a common upper bound. Consider the finite type of expressions consisting of finite unions of labels, top, pair intersections and triple intersections. All these expressions are quasi-compact at each stage: use finite-union compactness, quasi-separatedness and the affine compactness criterion. Each equality between expressions that holds on the limit becomes true at a later stage by eventual equality of compact opens. Finite quantification in the atTop filter gives one stage above i₀ where all such equalities hold. They imply every Valid field, encoding an inclusion C_d ≤ C_e as C_d = C_d intersect C_e. Inverse image preserves the expressions, so valid collections remain valid at every later stage.

For each stage chart, its opensDiagram has affine objects and its opensCone is limiting. On any thin cofiltered diagram of affine schemes, global sections take the limit to a ring colimit. Replace the opposite indexing category by its thin skeleton, a directed partial order. Extend the finitely presented sections of the restricted module along the inverse canonical ring-colimit comparison. Apply the preorder module-model theorem. Cocone compatibility and extendScalarsComp, followed by cancellation of extension along inverse ring isomorphisms, identify the resulting model with the sections of the original restricted sheaf. Realize it as a finitely presented quasi-coherent sheaf using affine sections realization. The tensor/native pullback comparison comes from uniqueness of the left adjoint to pushforward.

Choose a common upper bound for the finitely many chart-model indices and the geometric stage. Pull each chart and its sheaf model to this common stage. Restricted transition maps commute with the restricted limit projections, proved after composing with the open immersion of the original stage chart. Tensor-pullback composition and the original model isomorphisms give the new sheaf comparisons. Tensor pullback preserves finite presentation; finite presentation supplies quasi-coherence. The Valid fields persist by inverse image. For the final opensDiagram, affine objects and isLimitOpensCone yield the requested canonical ring colimit by isColimitOfPreserves Scheme.Γ.

At each final chart apply exists_tensorPullback_affine_sections at the top affine opens. Rewrite its appLE ring map to appTop. Swap tensor factors and use its second-factor scalar-linearity to obtain a bijective map linear over the source chart ring. The specified unit of exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction is exactly tensorPullbackSection, so the pure-tensor formula is the required one. Compose the resulting module isomorphism with the global-sections isomorphism of the constructed sheaf comparison. This constructs HasFpLimitChartModel with the actual prescribed map.

I checked every cited statement against its step. Step 1: S is qcqs via the affine-cover criterion (1)/(2), affine⇒quasi-compact (permanence (3)) and the preimage-of-qc-open lemma, with no affine-overlap assumption. Step 2: pqf-lem-qs-intersection-qc on S, which Step 1 makes qs; the triple covers are subordinate by pointwise choice. Step 3: the Mathlib leaf lem-trf-affine-open-limit-descent (cofiltered, qs stages) plus a common bound. Step 4: inclusions and covers encoded as equalities of qc opens on the qcqs S_k, stabilized by clause (2) of pqf-lem-limit-qc-open-descends, so the stage covers really are covers. Step 5: the restriction and affine 01YW clauses of lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition give Γ(C_d) = colim via the canonical maps. Step 6: fp⇒qcoh and fp sections from lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-finite-type-affine (0)/(b), then the 05N7 object clause on the tail. Step 7: the hypotheses of lem-pc-fp-affine-sections-realization match exactly, with g.appTop the coprojection. Step 8: fp under tensor pullback without flatness, the composition iso of def-pc-module-pullback, and the affine sections iso of lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-affine-sections. No cycle: the dependency closure of 145 nodes contains neither the item nor its parent. Not duplicates: the picard-framework chart-model nodes (lem-pc-fp-local-object-models, -affine-chart-object-models, -module-map-descent, -local-descent-datum) all sit in the base-change-over-Noetherian-affine setting. Edge cases checked: singleton I, empty charts and empty S, non-separated qcqs schemes. All seven generic tool_uses are accepted. No SGA source is used. lean.statement: theorem exists_finitePresentation_affine_limit_chart_models {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)] (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I) (F : c.pt.Modules) (hF : F.IsFinitePresentation) : (∃ (K : FiniteAffineRefinementShape) (C : Fin K.size → c.pt.Opens), K.Valid C) ∧ ∀ (K : FiniteAffineRefinementShape) (C : Fin K.size → c.pt.Opens), K.Valid C → ∃ (i : I) (_ : i₀ ≤ i) (Ci : Fin K.size → (D.obj (op i)).Opens), K.Valid Ci ∧ ∀ d : Fin K.size, ∃ h : c.π.app (op i) ⁻¹ᵁ Ci d = C d, (∀ j : Over (op i), IsAffine ((opensDiagram D (op i) (Ci d)).obj j)) ∧ Nonempty (IsLimit (opensCone D c (op i) (Ci d))) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit (Scheme.Γ.mapCocone (opensCone D c (op i) (Ci d)).op)) ∧ HasFpLimitChartModel (c.π.app (op i)) (C d) (Ci d) h F
